title: Hybrid Semantic Tool Discovery for Enterprise MCP Gateway: Architecture and Implementation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents invoke external tools to retrieve and reason over information beyond pretrained knowledge. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how such tools are surfaced, and a proxy MCP server aggregates many backend servers behind a single endpoint providing a secure, governable chokepoint for authentication, policy enforcement, and observability. This architecture creates two compounding challenges: a context-engineering bottleneck where full tool schemas saturate the model context window before any user query, and a tool discoverability barrier where users and agents cannot identify the best tool among 2,000+ indexed tools across 200+ MCP servers. Prompt caching reduces reprocessing cost but neither frees context capacity nor improves accuracy. translated_title: 企业级MCP网关的混合语义工具发现：架构与实现
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）代理调用外部工具以检索和推理超出预训练知识的信息。模型上下文协议（MCP）标准化了此类工具的呈现方式，而代理MCP服务器将多个后端服务器聚合在单一端点之后，为身份验证、策略执行和可观测性提供了安全、可管理的控制点。这种架构带来了两个相互叠加的挑战：上下文工程瓶颈，即完整工具模式在任何用户查询之前就饱和了模型上下文窗口；以及工具可发现性障碍，即用户和代理无法在200多个MCP服务器中索引的2000多个工具中识别最佳工具。提示缓存降低了重新处理成本，但既不能释放上下文容量，也不能提高准确性。我们提出了SCOUT（通用工具的选择性上下文优化），将工具暴露重新定义为上下文选择问题，仅注入与当前任务相关的工具。
tldr: 本文提出SCOUT系统，通过将工具暴露视为上下文选择问题，仅注入相关工具，解决了企业MCP网关中上下文饱和和工具发现困难的双重挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SCOUT, which reframes tool exposure as a context-selection problem by injecting only relevant tools, addressing the dual challenges of context saturation and tool discoverability in enterprise MCP gateways.
